newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Clarke to unveil boost for PFI - papers.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Clarke to unveil boost for PFI - papers.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke, will announce on Monday seven billion stg has been committed to projects under the government's private finance initiative (PFI), The Sunday Times reported.
"He will give the figure at the annual PFI conference, at which the Treasury will also respond to criticisms of the initiative," the newspaper said.
The Sunday Telegraph reported that Clarke would forge closer links with business leaders to boost the PFI.

"Clarke will announce an "informal partnership' between the Treasury and the Confederation of British Industry to drive the initiative forward after protracted delays in signing off big infrastructure projects," The Sunday Telegraph said.

Clarke is anxious to restore confidence in the PFI following persistent private sector criticism that the bidding process is too costly and fears over the long-term financing of projects such as new hospitals, The Sunday Telegraph said.
Treasury officials were not available for comment.
